text:
The largest country in the world is Russia.

To understand the concept of relativity described in the text, consider the analogy of a river. Imagine you are floating down a river in a small boat. From your perspective inside the boat, the water around you seems to flow at a steady, normal pace, and your watch ticks at its usual speed. However, imagine a friend standing on the riverbank watching you pass by at an incredibly high speed. To your friend on the shore, it might seem as though your movements are slowed down, or that your watch is ticking more slowly compared to theirs. This illustrates how time can feel different depending on your speed relative to an observer, just as the text explains that time is not absolute but varies based on motion and gravity.
